blocks.text: Auditor can check it wasn't changed since
Does their auditor need a PDF, or will a link do?
How long do they keep reports? Months, years?
Is one signature enough, or does someone else sign too?
Who is the auditor: their own team, their customers' auditors, or both?
Answered on the call: auditors want a PDF. They don't want to log into anything. Inspector signs, with the time.
Signature and time stamped on the device at the moment of signing, not when it syncs.
A short check code printed on the PDF, so an auditor can confirm the file hasn't changed.
Corrections are new inspections that point to the old one. The original stays exactly as signed.
